elements.title: Observation of Floquet rotational super-radiance (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Observation of Floquet rotational super-radiance

A Floquet regime of rotational super-radiance has been observed in a spatiotemporally modulated ring network of resonators.

  • Hadiseh Nasari
  • Hady Moussa
  • Andrea Alù
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: In vivo feasibility study of humanoid robots in surgery (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
In vivo feasibility study of humanoid robots in surgery

A systematic evaluation shows that contemporary humanoid robots can perform laparoscopic surgical tasks through teleoperation, highlighting both their promise and key technical challenges before clinical deployment.

  • Zekai Liang
  • Nikita Thareja
  • Michael Yip
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Single-phase gradient-solvation-electrolyte-stabilized Li metal batteries (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Single-phase gradient-solvation-electrolyte-stabilized Li metal batteries

A targeted ligand anti-solvent is incorporated into an anion-rich ether-based electrolyte and used to achieve lithium metal batteries with a long cycle life, high energy density and high capacity retention.

  • Wujie Yang
  • Jianfeng Cai
  • Haoshen Zhou
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Non-genotoxic transplantation and in vivo selection through epitope editing (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Non-genotoxic transplantation and in vivo selection through epitope editing

Epitope editing of KIT enables antibody-based, non-genotoxic conditioning that selectively enriches therapeutic BCL11A-edited haematopoietic stem/progenitor cells, supports durable engraftment, preserves clonal diversity and enhances induction of fetal haemoglobin, a therapeutic approach for conditions such as sickle cell disease and β-thalassemia.

  • Gabriele Casirati
  • Andrea Cosentino
  • Pietro Genovese
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Architecture of the 8 MDa Hdr–Vhu–Fwd super-assembly in class I methanogens (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Architecture of the 8 MDa Hdr–Vhu–Fwd super-assembly in class I methanogens

The structure of the Hdr–Vhu–Fwd super-assembly reveals a lineage-specific and modular 8 MDa complex with the ability to adapt to diverse anaerobic niches.

  • Sophia Paul
  • Tomas C. Pascoa
  • Jan M. Schuller
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Reinforcement learning control of quantum error correction (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Reinforcement learning control of quantum error correction

By integrating reinforcement learning with quantum error correction, a quantum computer continuously self-calibrates during computation, achieving record logical error rates and enhanced resilience to drift.

  • Volodymyr Sivak
  • Alexis Morvan
  • Paul V. Klimov
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Large language models can predict the results of social science experiments (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Large language models can predict the results of social science experiments

Large language models can be used to estimate the results of social science experiments about as accurately as a group of human forecasters—even for experiments published after the models were trained—although they tended to overestimate effect sizes.

  • Ashwini Ashokkumar
  • Luke Hewitt
  • Robb Willer
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Ancient feeding-related neuropeptides regulate alloparenting in ants (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Ancient feeding-related neuropeptides regulate alloparenting in ants

Pharmacological screening and behavioural assays in ants identify two specific neuropeptides that have key and opposite effects in regulating brood care, and that link nutritional state to age-dependent changes in parenting behaviour.

  • Alexander Paul
  • Tomas Kay
  • Daniel J. C. Kronauer
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Anatomy of a seafloor spreading event captured by in situ seismogeodesy (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Anatomy of a seafloor spreading event captured by in situ seismogeodesy

By combining hydroacoustic, direct-path ranging and bottom-pressure measurements, in situ observations of a rifting event at a segment of the Southeast Indian Ridge are reported, providing insight into seafloor spreading events on yearly timescales.

  • Jean-Yves Royer
  • Jean-Arthur Olive
  • L. Testut
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Reconfigurable mmWave microchips co-integrating hBN switches on GaN (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Reconfigurable mmWave microchips co-integrating hBN switches on GaN

Radio-frequency switches made from two-dimensional layered hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) were co-integrated on gallium nitride (GaN) microchips to build programmable millimetre-wave (mmWave) monolithic microwave integrated circuits suitable for 6G hardware.

  • Sebastian Pazos
  • Andrés Fontana
  • Mario Lanza
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Air-permeable hydrogels through viscoelastic phase separation of aerogels (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Air-permeable hydrogels through viscoelastic phase separation of aerogels

Viscoelastic phase separation is used to fabricate non-collapsible, air-rich networks in high-water-content hydrogels containing silica aerogel beads, allowing air to permeate through the material and enabling a tenfold increase in oxygen permeability over pristine hydrogels.

  • Xiao-Yun Yan
  • Shucong Li
  • Xuanhe Zhao
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Verification of the Outer Space Treaty with cosmic protons (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Verification of the Outer Space Treaty with cosmic protons

By observing the neutrons induced by spallation from protons in the inner Van Allen radiation belts using widely available sensor technologies, the detection of a thermonuclear weapon carried by a space satellite is possible.

  • Areg Danagoulian
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Aneuploidy selects for the acquisition of driver genes in breast cancer (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Aneuploidy selects for the acquisition of driver genes in breast cancer

Screening of chromosome arm-level aneuploidies uncovers that these alterations select for specific basal-like breast cancer driver genes, including PLGRKT, an oncogene whose tumour-promoting activity is associated with highly stress-resistant mitochondria and enhanced detoxification of reactive oxygen species.

  • Khalid N. Al-Zahrani
  • Ellen R. Langille
  • Daniel Schramek
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Universal cell embedding provides a foundation model for cell biology (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Universal cell embedding provides a foundation model for cell biology

The universal cell embedding foundation model learns to capture the organization and variation of cells by training on 36 million cells from hundreds of experiments, dozens of tissues and eight species.

  • Yanay Rosen
  • Yusuf Roohani
  • Jure Leskovec
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: LARES-2 satellite measures frame-dragging effect around the Earth (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
LARES-2 satellite measures frame-dragging effect around the Earth

Using LARES-2, LAGEOS and GRACE satellites, researchers measured Earth’s frame-dragging with unprecedented precision, strongly confirming general relativity, constraining alternative gravity theories, and improving measurements of Earth’s tides.

  • Ignazio Ciufolini
  • Antonio Paolozzi
  • Vahe Gurzadyan
Article08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Chromatin landscape and epigenetic heterogeneity of acute myeloid leukaemia (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Chromatin landscape and epigenetic heterogeneity of acute myeloid leukaemia

An ATAC-seq-based approach is used to classify acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) into 16 epigenomic subgroups, and provides insight into the role of non-genetic mechanisms in determining pathogenesis, clinical behaviour and drug sensitivity in this disease.

  • Yotaro Ochi
  • Markus Liew-Littorin
  • Seishi Ogawa
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Diet–microbiome synergy underlies obesity-associated immunotherapy efficacy (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Diet–microbiome synergy underlies obesity-associated immunotherapy efficacy

Diet shapes obesity-associated therapeutic responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors through gut microbial metabolism and host anti-tumour immunity, demonstrated in mouse custom-diet models and human-to-mouse fecal microbiota transplantation experiments.

  • Lysanne Desharnais
  • Anikka Swaby
  • Daniela F. Quail
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: Intergenerational mobility fosters innovation in Europe (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
Intergenerational mobility fosters innovation in Europe

The EUROPE-IGM-ATLAS reveals spatiotemporal trends that characterize the changing geography of opportunity in Europe and its relationship with regional innovation.

  • Sarah McNamara
  • Guido Neidhöfer
  • Patrick Lehnert
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: An intrinsic cytoskeletal oscillator establishes neuronal polarity (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
An intrinsic cytoskeletal oscillator establishes neuronal polarity

The ARP2/3 complex works together with actomyosin in an oscillatory program at the soma to govern neuronal polarization.

  • Tien-chen Lin
  • Charlotte H. Coles
  • Frank Bradke
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026

elements.title: The forest of knowledge under global change (Nature - research articles)
elements.contents:
The forest of knowledge under global change

The biocultural heritage of the Amazon, its plant species, plant services and cultures are at risk from climate change.

  • Rodrigo Cámara-Leret
  • Patrick R. Roehrdanz
  • Jordi Bascompte
ArticleOpen Access08 Jul 2026
